hints.title: Joining Sentence with Separating Spaces
hints.text: Join the sentence into a single repeating circular string with spaces. Each row on screen advances across this circular stream by cols characters.

hints.title: Backtracking Mid-Word Word Wraps
hints.text: If a row ends in the middle of a word, retreat to the preceding space boundary so that words are never split across lines.

hints.title: Pointer Advancement Across Screen Rows
hints.text: Let s be sentence joined by space plus trailing space of length n. For each row, add cols to start. If s[start % n] is space, advance 1; else retreat while s[(start - 1) % n] is not space. Return start // n.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: L: length of joined sentence string
complexity.notes: Optimal simulation running in O(R * W) time with O(L) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Word-by-word simulation loops millions of times for large row counts.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating row jumps on circular joined string avoids tracking nested word pointers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle word wrapping correctly without splitting words across lines.
